root: ^Cacildes: Ouch… my head. I’m lucky it’s still attached to my shoulders.
^Cacildes: Damn it… This was supposed to be my chance to prove myself, and instead I let the spy slip away with the stone’s location.
^Cacildes: I’d better get back to the General and tell him what happened. If I’m lucky, I might still have a job sweeping the barracks.
